<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5e8e24302dca5cf4dbda2b97dca4c732c022e7b6` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: 75e68ba51d5c9616b99d43b97b6ae2292c713e39 · read 2026-11-22T00:42Z · first full read (no prior L1-b record on this PR) · L1 is final on this head (Clause-② no, no L2 per seat)

### 维护者速读
这是 #35955 第三步的浏览器部分：列表的列宽、行高和视图页签顺序以后只记在当前浏览器里（按登录用户和对象分开），不再存到服务器的个人偏好里。用户会看到的变化：列表打开不再等服务器读偏好，直接显示；换一台电脑或换一个浏览器，列表按视图自己的列宽、行高和页签顺序打开（这是 Sales 在 #35955 上定的 D1）；退出登录照旧清掉这些记忆（保留同一人记忆是后续卡 #36110）。升级代价：老版本存过的列宽、行高、页签顺序不迁移，大家会回到视图默认，需要重新拖一次；浏览器里旧的 `list-state:*`、`list-filters:*`、`viewOrder:*` 在第一次打开列表时删除。服务器上旧的偏好行这次不删，只是不再读，由后续的命令 PR（`os migrate list-preferences`）处理。没有元数据键、值或默认值变化。

### Must-fix
None.

### Should-fix
None.

### Nits (no change needed to land)
- N1 `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/listLayoutStore.ts:297`: `clearRetiredListStateKeysOnce()` runs in the hook's render body, so the sweep is a side effect of render. It is guarded by a module flag, idempotent and only removes keys nothing reads, so StrictMode double render and concurrent rendering are harmless. Moving it into a one-time effect or module init would be tidier, not needed.
- N2 Changeset "Upgrade note": "The server rows stay where they are, unread" is true for this PR. When the command PR lands, its own changeset should say the operator command is how those rows are removed; nothing to change here.

### Checked
- l1-face CLEAN; CI on 75e68ba5: 61 success, 9 skipped, 0 failing.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only origin/main 75e68ba5`: clean; origin/main is af2361ee, the merge base, so the PR diff read is exactly af2361ee..75e68ba5 (35 files, +1124/−1824).
- New store `listLayoutStore.ts`: key `list-layout:<userId>:<object>`, null with no user or no object (no `anon` key, per the 14:40Z ruling); values pass sanitize (widths positive numbers, spec rowHeight vocabulary, non-empty string view ids; every retired part such as sort, filters, column order, hidden/added columns dropped); `writeListLayout` removes an empty entry and notifies; reads through useSyncExternalStore with raw-text snapshots; no network. Slot test `listLayoutStore.slot-35955.test.tsx` pins each of these, including a `fetch` spy that is never called.
- Retired-key sweep: `list-state:`, `list-filters:`, `viewOrder:` were written only by the Console's own removed ListPreferencesProvider and listFilterStorage; other keys (locale, another object's `list-layout:`) survive, pinned.
- Every write site moved: objectViewListRenderer (column widths, density, reset of rowHeight), objectViewViewCrud (Manage Views drag → `setViewOrder`), ObjectView (view order sort key, `draftPreferenceOf`). `listDraftPreference` now reads `ListViewLayout` widths/rowHeight; shape types moved into listDraftStore.ts with personalViews.ts and objectViewListUrlState.ts re-pointed. The `listPrefs.ready` gate is gone from the renderer and the seed, so the list no longer renders a pending placeholder; the seed still waits on `viewResolving`.
- ConsoleShell / UserStateAdapters: ListPreferencesProvider and the `ui.list.` family are no longer attached; the boot read keeps the four keys and the `ui.record.` prefix (consoleUserPreferenceBudget pin re-pointed to say `ui.list.` is never asked for). RecordPreferencesProvider unchanged in behaviour.
- Walled posture pin `consoleListStateWall-12418`: sort and drag put no write of any kind on the wire, order lands in the layout entry; density likewise.
- Sign-out: `signOutPurge.test.tsx` shows `list-layout:*` and the old keys are removed by Log out, matching the changeset and the 14:40Z ruling (same-person keep is #36110).
- Repo-wide grep at head for `ListPreferencesProvider|listFilterStorage|useObjectListPreferences|LIST_PREFERENCE_PREFIX|useAttachListStateFamily`: no hit. Remaining `ui.list.` / `list-state:` hits are the docs and changeset history sentences, tests that seed the retired keys to prove they are swept or ignored, and the generic key-family adapter test in data-objectstack (adapter behaviour, not a Console caller).
- Docs read sentence by sentence: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` and the changeset agree with the code (browser-only, per user and object, nothing sent, another device opens the view's own, sign-out clears, no carry-over, old browser keys removed on first list); data-objectstack README and userState.ts examples now use `ui.record.`.
- Checklist `records-forms.json`, every clause of both touched items re-read:
  - adhoc filter/sort builder: rev 14 stays PR 2's entry, rev 15 is this PR's (steps[4], steps[5], acceptance[3] verify, source[1]); no clause left naming the retired row as a store or ListPreferencesProvider.
  - grid personalization: rev 9 → 10; steps[2], acceptance[1] verify, acceptance[4] clause/verify/evidence, source[2] re-pointed; the fresh-browser clause is flipped on purpose and the history says "Changed on purpose ... Sales ruling D1", which is the honest record (not presented as not-loosened).
- Merge resolutions: `ObjectView.sharedViewSave-35955.test.tsx` seeds the reader's row height through `listLayoutStorageKey('u1', OBJECT)` and resets the layout store; PR 2's assertion that the saver's row height stays theirs is unchanged.

### Owed
- One more main merge after #36212 (footer stats) lands: L1-b reads it as a merge-only delta.
- PR3b (`os migrate list-preferences`, the server-row delete) is a separate PR after this one merges; the seat sets its L2 tier then.

Head-sha: bb99349ced857c6932621dad0a3db5b297afa5d8 · read 2026-11-22T01:36Z · prior record ACCEPT 7071736973 @75e68ba5 · delta = main merge 4a50bbbd (main 5e8e2430, #36212 footer calculations as a draft part) + test commit bb99349c

### 维护者速读
这次只是把 #36212（底部统计进草稿）合进来，再修一个测试。合并时有三处冲突，处理方式都只是两边并存：草稿里有了底部统计，列宽、行高、页签顺序仍然只记在浏览器里。用户看到的行为和上次审过的一样，没有新增功能，也没有新的风险。

### Must-fix
None.

### Should-fix
None.

### Nits
None.

### Checked
- Merge 4a50bbbd parents 75e68ba5 + 5e8e2430 (origin/main tip at read); merge base af2361ee.
- Net-diff identity: `git diff af2361ee 75e68ba5` vs `git diff 5e8e2430 4a50bbbd` (changed lines only) differ in exactly three places, all conflict resolutions:
  - `listDraftStore.ts` header comment: #36212's "the footer's calculations" kept, and the "never holds" sentence keeps this PR's wording (widths, row height, tab order = browser layout, `./listLayoutStore.ts`); reflow only.
  - `listDraftStore.ts` imports: this PR's own `ListViewPreference` family types kept (ListPreferencesProvider is deleted here), #36212's `DraftColumnSummaries` import added.
  - `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`: #36212's `columnSummaryWrite` import added beside `useObjectListLayout`; the useMemo deps keep `listLayout.layout`/`listLayout.patchView` and take #36212's removal of `summaryPickKey`.
- Auto-merge tree (with conflict markers) vs 4a50bbbd: only those hunks; no code added beyond the resolutions.
- bb99349c: #36212's new shared-view footer case seeded the retired `list-state:` key for the reader's row height (which this PR no longer reads); re-pointed to `listLayoutStorageKey('u1', OBJECT)`, the same repoint as the PR 2 case. The assertion is unchanged.
- At head: no `listPrefs`, `ListPreferencesProvider`, `useObjectListPreferences` or `listFilterStorage` reference anywhere; #36212's added lines carry no other `ui.list.` / `sys_user_preference` / "remembered for the reader" text to re-point.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only origin/main bb99349c`: clean.
- CI on bb99349c at read: 4 success, 9 skipped, 24 in progress, 0 failing. This record is final once that run finishes green on this head with no new commit.

### Owed
- Green CI on bb99349c (the seat reads it before landing).
- PR3b (`os migrate list-preferences`) as its own PR after this merges.
